description: Puts a person of the account on a mailbox, which is what lets them read it. This is how a company takes back the correspondence of someone who has left; it is recorded, and the box shows it to whoever is on it. A box may be held by several people.

address.description: The address of the mailbox, for example "marie@sonentreprise.com": call list_mailboxes to find it. A support queue is not a mailbox: it has no holder and takes no alias.

person.description: The email address the person signs in with, which is not the same thing as the mailbox: it is how the account knows them.

name: add_mailbox_holder
title: Put someone on a mailbox
